shots.detail_en: CH on the rooftop at night, sketching 联华码头's candlesticks into his father's notebook until the line ends in a knife shape, tapping it with his pen cap
shots.sub: 长："爸，明天他们要看散户有多狠——我看他们有多急。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Next morning open: 联华码头 plunges a green bar and the retail crowd crushes forward into a wall
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: Close-up: green bars hammer down one after another, the volume tag flaring wide for the first time
shots.sub: 旁白："前三天是小声——今天，他们换了扩音器。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG clutches his chest as he squeezes to CH's side
shots.sub: 满："我全仓等的刀，落了第四次！你说刀不落第三次的！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: CH presses the one-minute-slow pocket watch into his palm, eyes unmoving
shots.sub: 长："第四次不是刀——是烟。满仓，捂上眼睛。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: 联华码头 slams onto its limit-down board, the whole row of the screen gone dead green
shots.sub: 散户乙："跌停了！单子排不出去了！"
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: Burst point: panic sell slips snow onto the counter windows, traders climbing over traders, a queue coiling at RED's window
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: CH slips sideways out of the crowd and leans his mop gently against the pillar
CH walks to the loneliest window at the far end of the counter, drawing a stack of pre-written paper slips from inside his jacket
shots.sub: 旁白："人踩人踩出来的价格，是我要的价格。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH feeds the first slips through the glass, his hat brim pulled low
shots.sub: 长："不急。分十笔——每笔小得像针尖。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Triple quick cuts: the 1st, 3rd and 10th return slips sliding back, CH tucking each one into his inner pocket
shots.sub: 旁白："飞刀落地滚三滚——滚到脚边，再伸手。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: RED counting slips behind the counter, her fingertip stopping on a small stack headed by the character 'Lu'
shots.sub: 红："一分钟三十七笔，笔笔小得像针尖——账面会记得每一只手。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close: the hall empties, the mop left standing by the pillar, CH's back disappearing through the rear door
shots.sub: 旁白："第一天，三十七刀全朝我——可我不疼。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI at the Lianhua tower: a matrix of trading accounts lighting up one red cell — the abnormal absorption
shots.sub: 熊伟："承接异常。同一时段、同一只票、三十七笔小单——像一只老鼠在接货。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI circles the account name 'Lu' in red on the screen
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: XIONG strolls over with his tea and gives the screen a single glance
shots.sub: 熊伟："爸，新老鼠。手法很老派。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: XIONG rolls his prayer beads, gaze settling on the character 'Lu'
shots.sub: 熊："老派——老派到只有一个老师傅教得出来。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI zooms in: every absorption order's timestamp falls one second past the minute — a whole beat slow
shots.sub: 熊伟："落单全慢一拍。什么老鼠——连表都是坏的。"
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Reversal hook: XIONG sets down his teacup, the prayer beads completing one full turn around his wrist as he smiles
shots.sub: 熊："那不是老鼠——是老熟人。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: XIONG at the floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the dark hall, his smile reflected in the glass
Black frame with the episode-end teaser card
shots.card: 猎人认出了猎物。猎物却打算明天，当众开口。
